character.description: Aerin swordsman, painted fantasy, SE front three-quarter. Chestnut hair, ivory sleeves, dark teal gold cloak, sword in right hand.

chroma_key.name: cyan
chroma_key.selection_reason: highest 1st-percentile subject distance among the 4 candidate(s) clearing the 96 erase radius

idle.action: Subtle relaxed breathing, feet stay planted, stable sword grip, one gentle blink. Same SE orientation.

walk.action: One complete six-phase walking cycle in place SE, alternate left and right foot contacts, low heel lifts, no running or jumping. Stable right hand sword and gently trailing cape.

style: Hand-painted ink and gouache fantasy game sprite. Match base proportions, face, costume and viewpoint exactly. Not pixel art.
